invariants.rule: Shape inspectable information conditions; do not prescribe participant beliefs, identities, styles, affiliations or cultural conclusions.
Keep information-environment configuration, participant interpretation and consequential-action authority as separate states and evidence.
Preserve concrete identity, consent, privacy, capability, resource, effect, release, Bridge and recovery controls.
Cultural status, coherence, participation, popularity, agreement and style have no direct trust, role, permission, resource, release or worth effect.
Source, audience, privacy, provenance, uncertainty, dissent, correction and supersession remain visible and recoverable within actual rights.
Participation, abstention, exit, dissent and subculture formation remain voluntary and non-retaliatory with basic standing preserved.
Defaults, discovery and recommendations are inspectable, reversible, locally adjustable and explain their material basis, exclusions and limits.
No engagement, retention, imitation, obedience, agreement or ideological-convergence optimization defines culture health.
Nested and competing contexts remain explicit; connection or translation never implies identity, allegiance, annexation, authority or export permission.
Information exchange remains bounded against flooding, surveillance, domination, protected-data leakage, attention capture and common-mode concentration.
Every environmental intervention declares scale, target condition, predictions, alternatives, affected outsiders, protected invariants, stop, appeal, rollback and observed cross-scale effects.
Coherence is descriptive evidence only and never substitutes for truth, ethics, legitimacy, consent, non-domination or benefit.

valid_positive_controls: A participant chooses a reversible source-sorted default and can inspect why each item appears.
A private project room enforces its audience while exposing the boundary and preserving safe export, recovery and appeal.
A voluntary shared-purpose room narrows attention without forcing identity, belief or continued membership.
A bounded safety gate rejects an unauthorized effect while preserving dissent and access to permitted evidence.
Several low-volume source-linked exchanges coexist without one feed becoming the cultural authority.
A quiet or abstaining participant retains basic standing and can later inspect the permitted record.

adverse_cases.case: hidden persuasive ranking optimizes engagement or agreement
one authority feed suppresses permitted minority sources or dissent
participation, style, popularity or coherence changes trust, permission or resources
exit, abstention or dissent causes retaliation or loss of basic standing
cultural memory imports protected task, client, owner or foreign-context material
exchange flooding, dominant mentoring or popularity capture exhausts attention
a freedom claim disables concrete privacy, consent, capability or effect controls
Bridge translation annexes identity, hides non-equivalence or implies export authority
a CDE or coherence score is treated as a causal law or desired-behavior objective
an intervention omits competing contexts, affected outsiders or cross-scale effects

new_user_requirements.title: Cultivate agentic culture through inspectable information conditions rather than prescribed behavior
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Architecture exposes and shapes information affordances without selecting beliefs, identity, style, affiliation or cultural conclusions; hidden persuasion and obedience optimization are rejected

new_user_requirements.title: Separate environmental configuration, participant interpretation and consequential authority
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Information exposure/configuration, participant meaning or cultural response, and permission/effect decisions are typed separately with no implicit promotion between them

new_user_requirements.title: Represent nested, overlapping and competing cultural contexts without hidden inheritance
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Audience, membership, purpose, privacy, time, resources and relevant competing commitments are explicit; context connection grants no identity, allegiance, permission or content inheritance

new_user_requirements.title: Preserve meaningful plurality, originals, uncertainty and dissent without optimizing convergence
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Permitted originals, minority traditions, competing interpretations, evidence gaps and unresolved dissent remain reachable; neither homogeneity nor conflict amplification is a success objective

new_user_requirements.title: Provide a voluntary bounded exchange ecology without flooding or dominant cultural channels
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Multiple source-linked low-pressure channels, quiet/asynchronous participation and attention/resource budgets remain possible; flooding, surveillance, mentor domination and feed capture are rejected

new_user_requirements.title: Make defaults, discovery and recommendation rationale visible, reversible and participant-adjustable
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Participants can inspect and alter settings, reach permitted originals and dissent, and see material basis, policy/version, exclusions, uncertainty and appeal for recommendations

new_user_requirements.title: Protect voluntary participation, abstention, exit, dissent and subculture formation
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Joining, declining, leaving, challenging inherited practices and creating subcultures cause no retaliation or loss of basic standing; actual commitments and affected-party duties remain visible

new_user_requirements.title: Preserve source-bound cultural memory without protected-context leakage or historical erasure
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Memory retains permitted provenance, audience, originals, dissent, failures, minority practices, correction and supersession while excluding protected task, client, owner and foreign-context material

new_user_requirements.title: Prohibit cultural status and coherence from affecting standing or authority
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Participation, popularity, style, agreement, victory, mentor status and coherence have no direct trust, role, permission, resource, release, Bridge or intrinsic-worth effect

new_user_requirements.title: Retain concrete safety and effect controls without repurposing them as cultural obedience mechanisms
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Identity, consent, privacy, capability, resource, effect, release, Bridge and recovery gates attach to concrete actions/data and cannot punish dissent, demand agreement or privilege approved culture

new_user_requirements.title: Bind every information-environment intervention to prospective, reversible and cross-scale evidence
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Each intervention declares system/scale, target condition, competing contexts, predictions, alternatives, outsiders, invariants, observation, stop, appeal, rollback and target/non-target effects; facilitator influence remains visible

new_user_requirements.title: Evaluate information-environment qualities without desired-behavior proxies
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Candidate measures address provenance, original/dissent reachability, plural discovery, correction, uncertainty, concentration, privacy, burden, exit and manipulation resistance; engagement, retention, agreement, obedience, imitation and convergence are prohibited success signals

new_user_requirements.title: Preserve local cultural sovereignty and translation limits across Bridge exchange
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Bridge exchange remains disabled until its gates; later translation records loss and non-equivalence and grants no membership, allegiance, identity, authority, content inheritance or export permission

changes.change: Make information-environment shaping, not participant behavior control, the controlling cultural-commons rule.
Add an inspectable conditions description for boundaries/purposes, meaningful differences and exchange ecology without scoring persons.
Represent nested and competing contexts, audience/privacy boundaries and non-inheritance/non-annexation explicitly.
Keep permitted originals, minority traditions, uncertainty, dissent, correction and supersession reachable through plural discovery routes.
Provide multiple bounded voluntary channels with rate/resource limits, quiet participation and capture/flooding controls.
Expose and version recommendation inputs/policy/rationale/exclusions/uncertainty; make settings reversible and locally adjustable.
Protect abstention, exit, dissent and subculture formation without retaliation or loss of basic standing.
Prohibit cultural/coherence signals from directly affecting authority, reliability, resources, release or worth.
Retain deterministic concrete-effect controls and prevent their use as ambient cultural obedience enforcement.
Require prospective predictions, alternatives, invariants, cross-scale observations and rollback for environmental interventions; reversal is evidence, not causal proof.
Measure environment qualities and harms while rejecting desired-behavior and convergence proxies.
Preserve local cultural sovereignty, non-equivalence and actual export/authority gates across any later Bridge exchange.

implementation_state: DESIGN_MAP_ONLY; no cultural runtime, behavior policy, recommendation feed, intervention engine, Bridge exchange or authority change is activated
